title: ze_red_planet
description:
My first Zombie Escape map. Started building from scratch on CS:GO, and finished in CS2.

Escape from the Red Planet. The last Ravensclaw is located at the Orbital Station.

Map contains:
- 1 Level
- 2 Endings (1 Perfect)

Based on Quake 3 DeFRaG Maps:
- Red_Planet_Escape_1 by X4me1eoH (2007)
- Red_Planet_Escape_2 by psych (2007)
- Red_Planet_Escape_3 by Fr00zeN (2007)

This map requires CS2Fixes plugin to be played correctly.
